clauses.title: Loan Amount
clauses.text: The Lender agrees to lend Rs. 1,50,000 to the Borrower.
clauses.simple: The lender is giving the borrower 1,50,000 rupees.

clauses.title: Tenure And EMI
clauses.text: The loan is repayable in 24 monthly instalments of Rs. 9,650 each, due on the 3rd of every month.
clauses.simple: The borrower must pay 9,650 rupees every month for 24 months.

clauses.title: Interest
clauses.text: Interest is charged at 2.5% per month on a flat basis. The interest rate is floating and linked to the Lender's internal benchmark.
clauses.simple: The interest rate is 2.5% per month and can change based on the lender's rules.
clauses.reason: Only a flat monthly rate of 2.5% is provided without an APR.

clauses.title: Fees
clauses.text: A processing fee of 4% of the loan amount will be deducted at disbursal, along with other charges as applicable from time to time.
clauses.simple: The lender will take a 4% fee from the money before giving it to the borrower.
clauses.reason: Includes open-ended 'other charges as applicable' which are against RBI rules.

clauses.title: Rate Changes
clauses.text: The Lender may revise the interest rate at its sole discretion without prior notice.
clauses.simple: The lender can change the interest rate whenever they want without telling you first.
clauses.reason: Lender can change rates at sole discretion without prior notice.

clauses.title: Prepayment
clauses.text: The Borrower may close the loan early by paying a foreclosure charge of 5% of the outstanding principal.
clauses.simple: If you pay the loan back early, you have to pay an extra 5% fee.
clauses.reason: Charging 5% foreclosure fee on a floating-rate loan is against RBI rules.

clauses.title: Late Payment
clauses.text: Delayed EMIs attract penal interest of 3% per month, compounded monthly and added to the outstanding loan.
clauses.simple: If you miss a payment, you will be charged an extra 3% interest every month.
clauses.reason: Compounding penal interest of 3% per month is against RBI rules.

clauses.title: Recovery
clauses.text: In case of default, the Lender and its recovery agents may contact the Borrower, her family members and the references provided, at any time, by phone, message or visit.
clauses.simple: If you don't pay, the lender can call or visit you and your family to get the money.
clauses.reason: Contacting family and references at any time is against RBI rules.

clauses.title: App Permissions
clauses.text: By accepting this agreement, the Borrower allows the QuickCash app to access her phone contacts, photo gallery and location for verification and recovery.
clauses.simple: The app is allowed to look at your contacts, photos, and location.
clauses.reason: Accessing phone contacts and photo gallery violates digital lending rules.

clauses.title: Governing Law
clauses.text: This agreement is governed by the laws of India, and courts in Mumbai shall have exclusive jurisdiction.
clauses.simple: Indian laws apply to this deal, and any legal fights will happen in Mumbai courts.

missing.label: Grievance officer
missing.why: Need contact for complaints to ensure fair treatment.

missing.label: Cooling-off period
missing.why: Borrower needs a period to exit the loan without penalty.
